title: PDF to Markdown - Text, Scanned OCR & PDF转Markdown
description: Minimal input: {"documentUrls": ["https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsvine/pdfplumber/stable/examples/pdfs/background-checks.pdf"], "startPage": 1, "maxPagesPerDocument": 5, "ocrMode": "disabled", "ocrLanguage": "eng"}. One paid row per nonempty PDF page.

documentUrls.title: documentUrls
documentUrls.description: Public PDF URLs. Up to 100, 12 MB each. One billed nonempty page. Default digital text; enable ocrMode=auto for scanned pages without text. Use ocrLanguage=chi_sim or eng+chi_sim for Chinese.

startPage.title: startPage
startPage.description: First PDF page to inspect, one-based, e.g. 2. Default 1. Pages before this are not inspected or billed.

maxPagesPerDocument.title: maxPagesPerDocument
maxPagesPerDocument.description: Maximum PDF pages inspected per document from startPage, 1–20; default 5. This is a scan cap, not a guaranteed row count. Pages without extracted text consume it but have no result fee. A delivered text-bearing page is billed even if it contains no tables; OCR pages with recognized text use the same page price. maxResults separately caps paid rows.

ocrMode.title: ocrMode
ocrMode.description: "disabled" (default) extracts digital PDF text only. "auto" applies printed-text OCR only to pages with no extractable text. Does not OCR images on text-bearing pages or repair bad text layers. One billed nonempty page, same price. 扫描PDF识别。

ocrLanguage.title: ocrLanguage
ocrLanguage.description: "eng" (default), "chi_sim" for simplified Chinese, or "eng+chi_sim" for mixed printed text. Used only when ocrMode=auto needs OCR; not automatic language detection. 中文扫描件识别。

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the run, 1–1000, default 20. Example: 3 for a sample. Exclusions and empty results apply before the cap.

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Prior output id values to skip before billing, up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Suppresses that identity even if content changed.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior output content_hash values (64 lowercase hex characters), up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Matching snapshots are skipped before billing.
